text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the shopping district, I spotted Yaeno Muteki and Seiun Sky
at a souvenir shop.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm............
What should I get as a souvenir for Grandpa...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, are you picking out
a souvenir for your grandfather?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Seiun Sky-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking of dropping by on my next day off,
so I'm looking for a souvenir for Gramp—my grandfather."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Weren't you just about
to say "Gramps"?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You misheard me!
There is no way I would casually
refer to my grandfather as 'Gramps.'

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so I misheard it~
My apologies for that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still, you're thinking about this quite seriously, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I were to pick a souvenir half-heartedly just because
it's 'only a souvenir,' my grandfather would see right through it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must do my absolute best with the souvenir so as not to appear rude.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That sounds rough. My grandpa is happy no matter what I give him, though~.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it does take a lot of hard work.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"However, that only makes the joy
all the greater when they are pleased."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
When they're happy with it, huh... I see~.
Then maybe I'll help pick out souvenirs too~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "I was actually just thinking about dropping by Grandpa's place next time I go home."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's reassuring.
Please let me know if you find anything good.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now, what should I choose...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "I know they said they'd be happy with anything, but if possible, I want to make them super happy, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I watch the two of them,
my eyes meet Seiun Sky's.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, were you listening to that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Man, picking out souvenirs is surprisingly tough once you really start overthinking it~
choice_data_list: You both really love your grandpa, don't you?
As long as your heart is in it, you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Rather than 'love'...
they've taken care of me since I was little, and I have immense respect for them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I visit home,
I always make sure to give my grandfather a shoulder massage.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In that case, wouldn't a "shoulder massage voucher"
make a great souvenir for your grandpa?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...!
I never thought about making souvenirs by hand. That might actually be a lovely idea.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so...?
I hope that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, that's a really good point~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You'll be fine as long as you pick while thinking, 'Grandpa will love this, Grandpa will love this'!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, I'll give it a try.
Gramps, be happy~... Gramps~..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nishishi, you totally said "Grandpa" just now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: T-That was just because Sky-san led me along!
